description: This file contains version parsing, comparison, and npm publish plan logic for managing release versions and publishing strategies in a software project, with regular expressions for different version formats and functions for decision-making.

methods.name: parseReleaseVersion
methods.description: Parses a version string into a structured release version object, supporting stable, beta, and correction version formats.

methods.name: compareReleaseVersions
methods.description: Compares two release version strings, returning their ordering based on date and version details.

methods.name: resolveNpmPublishPlan
methods.description: Determines the npm publishing plan based on the version and current beta version.

methods.name: resolveNpmDistTagMirrorAuth
methods.description: Resolves authentication info for npm distribution tags based on provided tokens.

methods.name: shouldRequireNpmDistTagMirrorAuth
methods.description: Determines whether npm distribution tags require authentication based on mode, tags, and auth status.
